text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Visiting park for break from work—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Next up, changeup coming in~! ...Hmph!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Swish— Thwack...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Alright, getting hang of it!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Nice pitch! Sandlot baseball game 
practically in bag now.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
All underclassmen gonna swoon and call 
Ryan-chan "cool" again♪ Big Sister Ines 
getting jealous~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ahaha... "cool", huh.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...Everyone cheered like that other day 
too, but I still lost race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I'm... nowhere near as cool as everyone 
makes me out to be.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ryan-chan...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, don't make worried face like that! 
Won't give up over that, of course!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
If I lose, just double muscle training! 
All about working hard for next race!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Real me gotta work hard to become "ideal 
me" everyone believes in!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, throw one more! Big Sis will 
catch your pitch!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Eh...? Y-Yeah...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Here it comes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Whiz— SMACK!!)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Nice pitch! Felt full weight of 
Ryan-chan's feelings...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
See? Ryan-chan is totally cool! When 
shining, when working hard, all of it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Eh...? W-What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
You're good at everything, always active 
and cool!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yet sometimes things don't go well, and 
you worry...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Even then, you never give up, stay 
refreshing every day, giving 100%!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
You're plenty cool as you are! Everyone 
loves that Ryan-chan!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I'm cool... as I am now...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yep! Big Sister Ines says so, no doubt 
about it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...Ahaha, I see!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if everyone else... feels same 
way.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Super cool! Cool when running! Cool when 
training, cool when smiling! So cool makes 
me fall in love~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait wait... saying it that many times 
gets really embarrassing...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Honestly accepting cheers—crucial mindset 
for horse girls running with crowd 
support.
